limitation: TASK_HEALTH validation panel saturates for strong policies
observation: V5 seed 3100001 produced byte-identical panels at 51k, 100k and 151k: pickups=46, captures=24, drops=22, wins=9, offensive_commitment=0.242102, net=19.

ruled_out.model_not_updating: checkpoints at 51,200 and 100,352 differ in ALL 20 parameter tensors (max |delta| 0.0339 on actor_cnn.conv.0.weight)
ruled_out.training_stalled: 75 updates, every logged metric distinct; entropy 3.498 -> 2.619, grad_norm 0.149 -> 1.036, rollout_reward 0.0002 -> 0.0036
ruled_out.panel_caching: run_validation_panel rebuilds a CustomPPOInferencePolicy from trainer.model and re-runs all episodes on every call
ruled_out.affects_all_seeds: seeds 3100002 and 3100003 show varying panels across the same interval

actual_cause: The panel is 3 opponents x 3 fixed seeds = 9 deterministic episodes, evaluated with deterministic=True action selection. Seed 3100001 wins 9/9. Once a policy dominates every validation episode and its argmax is stable along those trajectories, the episodes replay identically regardless of further parameter change. The panel has no resolution above 9/9.

consequences.for_condition_A_task_alive: unaffected — pickups/commitment are still measured correctly
consequences.for_condition_B_competence: unaffected — a saturated panel means the policy is winning everything, which is the competence claim
consequences.for_condition_D_attractor: REDUCED SENSITIVITY. A saturated panel cannot show the gradual deterioration Condition D looks for. For a 9/9 seed, Condition D is effectively blind and must rely on the training-success series instead.
consequences.for_reward_budget_E: unaffected — computed from metrics.csv, not the panel

not_changed_mid_run: The panel size and validation seeds are part of the frozen V5 contract. Enlarging them now would break the frozen gate and make V5 incomparable to V4.
recommendation_for_future_probes: Either enlarge the panel (more opponents/seeds) so strong policies retain headroom, or add a harder validation cell set specifically to preserve discrimination above 9/9. Note this trades panel cost against resolution: the panel runs at every checkpoint inside training.
reporting_rule_for_v5: Where a seed's panel is saturated, the V5 report must state that Condition D was evaluated primarily against the training-success series for that seed, rather than implying the panel confirmed stability.
